title: 2-Hour Time Machine Experience in Los Angeles
includes: Movie Props such has hover board, RCV Camcorder, Remote Control, almanac
With a valid drivers license and insurance you will be able to drive the car
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The DeLorean Time Machine from 'Back to the Future' is not just a car—it's a cultural icon that captures the essence of cinematic history, making it arguably the most iconic movie car ever made. 

What makes this activity unique is: The guest will be driven in the Delorean Time Machine, we will visit on our 2 hour tour, The Burger King from Back to the future where we will stop and can take photos and videos. Then we will head to Arleta to take photos and videos at Marty’s house, which is the house used in the actuall filming of Back to The Future. We then will head to south Pasadena to take pictures at George’s, Biffs and Louraine’s house. We are the only tour that will let you drive the Back to the Future Delorean - no on else will let you ever drive this vehicle on the streets. 

There is nothing like it period.
